name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-castle-extended
title: Super Mario World - Castle (Extended)
description:
The vanilla Super Mario World castle tile set but extended to be compatible with other vanilla ground objects, such as slopes, ledges and still water.

This can be used as a drop-in replacement for other FG3 tile sets (such as 1A in underground levels, etc) but is still compatible with vanilla castle background and stone objects.

Uses vanilla palettes and includes an optional map16 file for castle spikes, large stones and the big boss door with a bonus door handle variation (as shown the sample level).
